# Cleaning and merging data

Data export from script 2 needs to be reformatted to fit with dataset from previous years.

## Load packages

```{r}

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sciplot)
library(boot)
library(Matrix)
library(lme4)
library(vegan)
library(tibble)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(here)
library(openxlsx)
```

## Import data

```{r}

#Plot data

plot_2026 <- read_excel(here::here("data", 
                                   "S123_2026", 
                                   "Exports", 
                                   "Honningblom_2026_data_analyses.xlsx"), sheet = "plots")

plot_2014_25_herminium <- read_excel(here::here("data",
                                                "Herminium_monorchis_masterfile_v_2025.xlsx"),sheet="Plot_herminium")

plot_2014_25_environment <- read_excel(here::here("data",
                                                "Herminium_monorchis_masterfile_v_2025.xlsx"),sheet="Plot_environment")

#import species data

plot_species_2026 <- read_excel(here::here("data", 
                                           "S123_2026",
                                           "Exports", 
                                           "Honningblom_2026_data_analyses.xlsx"), sheet = "plot_species_long")

species_list_2026 <- read_excel(here::here("data", 
                                           "S123_2026", 
                                           "Diagnostics", 
                                       "Honningblom_2026_plot_species_names.xlsx"), sheet = "Sheet 1")

# importing locality file 
locality_2014_25_herminium <- read_excel(here::here("data", 
                                                  "Herminium_monorchis_masterfile_v_2025.xlsx"), sheet = "Locality")
  

#importing transect data
transect_2026 <- read_excel(here::here("data", 
                                       "S123_2026", 
                                       "Honningblom_2026_transect_processed", 
                                       "Honningblom_2026_transect_transect_export_dirty.xlsx"), sheet = "Sheet 1")

transect_2014_25 <- read_excel(here::here("data", 
                                          "Herminium_monorchis_masterfile_v_2025.xlsx"), sheet = "Transect")


#import other sheets from old masterfile

Plot_soil_fungi <- read_excel(here::here("data", "Herminium_monorchis_masterfile_v_2025.xlsx"), sheet="Plot_soil_fungi")

Locality_root_seed_fungi <- read_excel(here::here("data", "Herminium_monorchis_masterfile_v_2025.xlsx") ,sheet="Locality_root_seed_fungi")

Plot_plants <- read_excel(here::here("data", "Herminium_monorchis_masterfile_v_2025.xlsx"), sheet="Plot_plants")

Plot_gps <- read_excel(here::here("data", "Herminium_monorchis_masterfile_v_2025.xlsx"), sheet="Plot_gps")

Reintroduction <- read_excel(here::here("data",
                                        "Herminium_monorchis_masterfile_v_2025.xlsx"),sheet="Reintroduction")


```

## Reformatting datasets

```{r}
## reformatting datasets
plot_2014_25_environment<- plot_2014_25_environment %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(5:12,15,18:23),as.numeric)
  )

plot_2014_25_herminium <- plot_2014_25_herminium %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(7,9:14),as.numeric)
  )

plot_2026 <- plot_2026 %>%
  mutate(main_date = as.Date(main_date, format = "%Y%m%d"),
         year = as.numeric(year))

# creating variable names that correspond to existing dataset

plot_2026_rev <- plot_2026 %>%
  rename(
    Date = main_date,
    Year = year,
    Locality = main_location_id,
    Plot_ID_new = main_plot_id,
    Observer = main_observant_name,
    Fieldlayer_cover = plot_cover_fieldlayer,
    Groundlayer_cover = plot_cover_bottomlayer,
    Litter_cover = plot_cover_litter,
    Lowwoody_cover = plot_cover_lowwoody,
    Vegetation_height_1 = plot_height_vegetation1,
    Vegetation_height_2 = plot_height_vegetation2,
    Vegetation_height_3 = plot_height_vegetation3,
    Vegetation_height_4 = plot_height_vegetation4,
    Herminium_count_fertile = plot_freq_focalspecies2,
    Herminium_count_vegetative = plot_freq_focalspecies1
  )

plot_2026_rev <- plot_2026_rev %>%
  mutate(Comment = paste(plot_management_type, plot_management_comments, main_comments, plot_vegetation_comments, sep = ";"))

#creating variables for Mowing and Grazing (percentage cover)
plot_2026_rev <- plot_2026_rev %>%
  mutate(value = 1) %>%   # hjelpekolonne
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = plot_management_type,
    values_from = value,
    values_fill = 0,
    names_prefix = "plot_"
  )

plot_2026_rev <- plot_2026_rev %>%
  mutate(
    Mowing = case_when(
      plot_Slått == 1 ~ plot_management_cover,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    Grazing = case_when(
      plot_Beite == 1 ~ plot_management_cover,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ))

# for plots with Beite,Bur, include cover in "Grazing" variable
plot_2026_rev <- plot_2026_rev %>%
  mutate(Grazing = if_else(Plot_ID_new %in% c("TEN5","TEN4"),
                               100,
                               Grazing)
  )

# add zeros to empty rows
plot_2026_rev <- plot_2026_rev %>%
  mutate(
    Mowing = replace_na(Mowing, 0),
    Grazing = replace_na(Grazing, 0)
  )

## splitting into three separate sheets, one for herminium and one for environment, and one general with info on dates, observer etc. 
plot_2026_herminium <- plot_2026_rev %>%
  select(c(Locality,Year,Plot_ID_new,Herminium_count_fertile,Herminium_count_vegetative)
  )


plot_2026_environment <- plot_2026_rev %>%
  select(c(Locality,Year,Plot_ID_new,Vegetation_height_1,Vegetation_height_2,Vegetation_height_3,Vegetation_height_4,Fieldlayer_cover,Groundlayer_cover,Litter_cover,Lowwoody_cover,Mowing,Grazing,Comment)
  )

plot_2026_general <- plot_2026_rev %>%
  select(c(Locality,Year,month,day,Date,Observer,Plot_ID_new))
```

## Finalizing Herminium sheet

```{r}
### plot_herminium
## adding the variables that are missing
plot_2026_herminium <- plot_2026_herminium %>%
  mutate(
    Herminium_count_total = coalesce(Herminium_count_vegetative, 0) +
      coalesce(Herminium_count_fertile, 0),
    
    Herminium_fraction_fertile = if_else(
      Herminium_count_total == 0 |
        is.na(Herminium_count_vegetative) |
        is.na(Herminium_count_fertile),
      NA_real_,
      Herminium_count_fertile / Herminium_count_total
    )
  )
  

# merging the two files into one
Plot_herminium <- bind_rows(
  plot_2014_25_herminium,
  plot_2026_herminium
) %>%
  mutate(
    Locality = replace(Locality, Locality == "Teneskjær", "Teneskjaer"), 
    Locality = replace(Locality, Locality == "Skipstadsand.", "Skipstadsand")
  )

vars_to_copy <- c(
  "Plot_ID_old",
  "All_years",
  "Active",
  "Plot_size",
  "Compass_direction",
  "Distance_from_center"
)

values_2025 <- Plot_herminium %>%
  filter(Year == 2025) %>%
  select(Plot_ID_new, all_of(vars_to_copy)) %>%
  distinct(Plot_ID_new, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  rename_with(
    ~ paste0(.x, "_2025"),
    all_of(vars_to_copy)
  )

Plot_herminium <- Plot_herminium %>%
  left_join(values_2025, by = "Plot_ID_new") %>%
  mutate(
    Plot_ID_old = if_else(
      Year == 2026 & is.na(Plot_ID_old),
      Plot_ID_old_2025,
      Plot_ID_old
    ),
    All_years = if_else(
      Year == 2026 & is.na(All_years),
      All_years_2025,
      All_years
    ),
    Active = if_else(
      Year == 2026 & is.na(Active),
      Active_2025,
      Active
    ),
    Plot_size = if_else(
      Year == 2026 & is.na(Plot_size),
      Plot_size_2025,
      Plot_size
    ),
    Compass_direction = if_else(
      Year == 2026 & is.na(Compass_direction),
      Compass_direction_2025,
      Compass_direction
    ),
    Distance_from_center = if_else(
      Year == 2026 & is.na(Distance_from_center),
      Distance_from_center_2025,
      Distance_from_center
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with("_2025"))


# Calculate indivuals per 0,25 m²
Plot_herminium <- Plot_herminium %>%
  mutate(
    Herminium_density_0.25m2 = Herminium_count_total * 0.25 / Plot_size
  )
```

## Finalizing environment sheet

```{r}

### plot_environment
#include mean vegetation height
plot_2026_environment <- plot_2026_environment %>%
  mutate(Vegetation_height_mean = rowMeans(
    select(.,Vegetation_height_1:Vegetation_height_4),
    na.rm=TRUE
  ))  

plot_species_2026 <- plot_species_2026 %>%
  rename(Plot_ID_new = main_plot_id)

species_list_2026 <- species_list_2026 %>%
  mutate(
    Overgrowth_species = NA_integer_,
    Redlist_species = NA_integer_
  )

# coding overgrowth and redlist species
species_list_2026 <- species_list_2026 %>%
  mutate(
    Overgrowth_species = case_when(
      pref_popular_name %in% c(
        "svartor",
        "sløke",
        "åkertistel",
        "myrtistel",
        "veitistel",
        "mjødurt",
        "einer",
        "strandkjeks",
        "pors",
        "furuslekta",
        "furu",
        "modell",
        "slåpetorn",
        "roseslekta",
        "vierslekta",
        "rogn"
      ) ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    Redlist_species = case_when(
      pref_popular_name %in% c(
        "hjertegras",
        "tusengylden",
        "engmarihand",
        "bukkebeinurt",
        "ormetunge",
        "krattalant",
        "bitterblåfjær",
        "krusfrø",
        "gulfrøstjerne",
        "kystfrøstjerne"
      ) ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )

# including popular name and coding them in the plot species file
plot_species_2026 <- plot_species_2026 %>%
  left_join(
    species_list_2026 %>%
      select(original_name, pref_popular_name),
    by = c("plot_species" = "original_name")
  )

plot_species_2026 <- plot_species_2026 %>%
  left_join(
    species_list_2026 %>%
      select(
        original_name,
        pref_popular_name,
        Overgrowth_species,
        Redlist_species
      ),
    by = c("plot_species" = "original_name")
  )

# listing species in each category in the plot_environment dataset
species_summary <- plot_species_2026 %>%
  select(
    Plot_ID_new,
    pref_popular_name.x,
    Overgrowth_species,
    Redlist_species
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Overgrowth_species, Redlist_species),
    names_to = "species_category",
    values_to = "selected"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    selected == 1,
    !is.na(pref_popular_name.x),
    pref_popular_name.x != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Plot_ID_new,
    species_category,
    pref_popular_name.x
  ) %>%
  group_by(Plot_ID_new, species_category) %>%
  summarise(
    species = paste(
      sort(unique(pref_popular_name.x)),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = species_category,
    values_from = species
  )


plot_2026_environment <- plot_2026_environment %>%
  left_join(
    species_summary,
    by = "Plot_ID_new"
  )

## making cover variables for overgrowth and redlist species

species_cover_summary <- plot_species_2026 %>%
  select(
    Plot_ID_new,
    pref_popular_name.x,
    plot_cover_species,
    Overgrowth_species,
    Redlist_species
  ) %>%
  
  # Gjør kategoriene om til langformat
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Overgrowth_species, Redlist_species),
    names_to = "species_category",
    values_to = "selected"
  ) %>%
  
  # Behold bare arter kodet med 1
  filter(
    selected == 1,
    !is.na(pref_popular_name.x),
    pref_popular_name.x != ""
  ) %>%
  
  # Summer hvis samme art forekommer flere ganger i samme rute
  group_by(
    Plot_ID_new,
    species_category,
    pref_popular_name.x
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    species_cover = sum(plot_cover_species, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  
  # Sorterer arter alfabetisk slik at arter og dekning får samme rekkefølge
  arrange(
    Plot_ID_new,
    species_category,
    pref_popular_name.x
  ) %>%
  
  # Lager artsliste, liste over dekning og total dekning
  group_by(Plot_ID_new, species_category) %>%
  summarise(
    species = paste(pref_popular_name.x, collapse = ", "),
    cover_per_species = paste(species_cover, collapse = ", "),
    total_cover = sum(species_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  
  # Lager separate kolonner for gjengroingsarter og rødlistearter
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = species_category,
    values_from = c(species, cover_per_species, total_cover),
    names_glue = "{species_category}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  
  rename(
    Overgrowth_species = Overgrowth_species_species,
    Overgrowth_cover_per_species =
      Overgrowth_species_cover_per_species,
    Overgrowth_cover =
      Overgrowth_species_total_cover,
    
    Redlist_species = Redlist_species_species,
    Redlist_cover_per_species =
      Redlist_species_cover_per_species,
    Redlist_cover =
      Redlist_species_total_cover
  )

# linking with the plot data
plot_2026_environment <- plot_2026_environment %>%
  select(
    -any_of(c(
      "Overgrowth_species",
      "Overgrowth_cover_per_species",
      "Overgrowth_cover",
      "Redlist_species",
      "Redlist_cover_per_species",
      "Redlist_cover"
    ))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    species_cover_summary,
    by = "Plot_ID_new"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Overgrowth_cover = replace_na(Overgrowth_cover, 0),
    Redlist_cover = replace_na(Redlist_cover, 0)
  )

# Metadata
plot_2026_general <- plot_2026_general %>%
  mutate(Observer = recode(
    Observer,
    "RR" = "Roos, Ruben Erik",
    "AS" = "Skrindo, Astrid Brekke",
    ",AS" = "Skrindo, Astrid Brekke",
    "As" = "Skrindo, Astrid Brekke",
    "ASP" = "Skrindo, Astrid Brekke",
    "ASSkjellvik" = "Skrindo, Astrid Brekke"
  ))

```

Merge the datafiles

```{r}
# merging the two files into one
Plot_environment <- bind_rows(plot_2014_25_environment, plot_2026_environment) 

vars_to_copy <- c(
  "Plot_ID_old",
  "All_years",
  "Active",
  "Plot_size",
  "Compass_direction",
  "Distance_from_center"
)

values_2025 <- Plot_herminium %>%
  filter(Year == 2025) %>%
  select(Plot_ID_new, all_of(vars_to_copy)) %>%
  distinct(Plot_ID_new, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  rename_with(
    ~ paste0(.x, "_2025"),
    all_of(vars_to_copy)
  )

Plot_herminium <- Plot_herminium %>%
  left_join(values_2025, by = "Plot_ID_new") %>%
  mutate(
    Plot_ID_old = if_else(
      Year == 2026 & is.na(Plot_ID_old),
      Plot_ID_old_2025,
      Plot_ID_old
    ),
    All_years = if_else(
      Year == 2026 & is.na(All_years),
      All_years_2025,
      All_years
    ),
    Active = if_else(
      Year == 2026 & is.na(Active),
      Active_2025,
      Active
    ),
    Plot_size = if_else(
      Year == 2026 & is.na(Plot_size),
      Plot_size_2025,
      Plot_size
    ),
    Compass_direction = if_else(
      Year == 2026 & is.na(Compass_direction),
      Compass_direction_2025,
      Compass_direction
    ),
    Distance_from_center = if_else(
      Year == 2026 & is.na(Distance_from_center),
      Distance_from_center_2025,
      Distance_from_center
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with("_2025"))
```

## Locality data

```{r}
# adding data from 2026
locality_2014_25_herminium <- locality_2014_25_herminium %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y%m%d"),
         Year = as.numeric(Year))

nye_2026 <- locality_2014_25_herminium %>%
  filter(Year == 2025) %>%
  mutate(Year = 2026)

nye_2026 <- nye_2026 %>%
  mutate(
    Date = case_when(
      Locality == "Filletassen" ~ as.POSIXct("01.07.2026", format = "%d.%m.%Y", tz = "UTC"),
      Locality == "Skipstadsand" ~ as.POSIXct("30.06.2026", format = "%d.%m.%Y", tz = "UTC"),
      Locality == "Skjellvik" ~ as.POSIXct("02.07.2026", format = "%d.%m.%Y", tz = "UTC"),
      Locality == "Teneskjaer" ~ as.POSIXct("30.06.2026", format = "%d.%m.%Y", tz = "UTC"),
      TRUE ~ Date
    ),  
    Observer = case_when(
      Locality == "Filletassen" ~ "RR",
      Locality == "Skipstadsand" ~ "RR, ABS",
      Locality == "Skjellvik" ~ "RR, ABS",
      Locality == "Teneskjær" ~ "RR, ABS",
      TRUE ~ Observer
    )
  )

locality_2014_26_herminium <- bind_rows(locality_2014_25_herminium, nye_2026) %>%
  arrange(Year, Locality)

## changing info on time-use and other comments
locality_2014_26_herminium <- locality_2014_26_herminium %>%
  mutate(
    Time_use = case_when(
      Locality == "Filletassen" & Year == 2026 ~ 4.5,
      Locality == "Skipstadsand" & Year == 2026 ~ 8,
      Locality == "Skjellvik" & Year == 2026 ~ 14,
      Locality == "Teneskjær" & Year == 2026 ~ 7,
      TRUE ~ Time_use
    ),
    Comment = case_when(
      Locality == "Filletassen" & Year == 2026 ~ "Inkludert reise, en person jobbet fra ca. 9-12",
      Locality == "Skipstadsand" & Year == 2026 ~ "To personer 10.30-14.30, inkl. NRK-intervju",
      Locality == "Skjellvik" & Year == 2026 ~ "To personer, 8-16, ekstremt dårlig vær",
      Locality == "Teneskjær" & Year == 2026 ~ "To personer, 16-19.30",
      TRUE ~ Comment
    )
  )

```

## Transect data

```{r}
# removing test data
transect_2026 <- transect_2026 %>%
  filter(main_location_id != "Feltspatveien")
# renaming variables to fit with current dataset
transect_2026 <- transect_2026 %>%
  rename(
    Date = event_time,
    Year = year,
    Locality = main_location_id,
    Transect_ID = main_transect_id,
    Transect_length = transect_length,
    Comment = transect_registration_comments,
    Presence_m = plot_subplots,
    Presence_half_m = ruter_05
  )

# making variables "Number_half_m_presence" and "Number_m_presence"
transect_2026 <- transect_2026 %>%
  mutate(
    Number_half_m_presence = if_else(
      is.na(Presence_half_m) | Presence_half_m == "", 
      0L, str_count(Presence_half_m, ",") + 1L
    ),
    Number_m_presence = if_else(
      is.na(Presence_m) | Presence_m == "",
      0L, str_count(Presence_m, ",") + 1L
    )
  )

# saving the columns I need, and changing columns to align with old data
transect_2026_clean <- transect_2026 %>%
  select(c(Locality, Year, Date, Transect_ID, Transect_length,Number_half_m_presence,Number_m_presence,Presence_m,Presence_half_m,Comment))
transect_2026_clean <- transect_2026_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.numeric(Year),
    Date = as.POSIXct(as.character(Date),format = "%Y%m%d",tz = "UTC"),
    Number_half_m_presence = as.character(Number_half_m_presence),
    Number_m_presence = as.character(Number_m_presence)
    )
  

```

Merging with existing data

```{r}
Transect_2014_26 <- bind_rows(transect_2014_25, transect_2026_clean) 

```

## Assemble masterfile

```{r}

wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "Locality")
writeData(wb, "Locality", locality_2014_26_herminium)

addWorksheet(wb, "Transect")
writeData(wb, "Transect", Transect_2014_26)

addWorksheet(wb, "Plot_herminium")
writeData(wb, "Plot_herminium", Plot_herminium)

addWorksheet(wb, "Plot_environment")
writeData(wb, "Plot_environment", Plot_environment)

addWorksheet(wb,"Plot_General")
writeData(wb,"Plot_General",plot_2026_general)

addWorksheet(wb,"Plot_soil_fungi")
writeData(wb,"Plot_soil_fungi",Plot_soil_fungi)

addWorksheet(wb,"Locality_root_seed_fungi")
writeData(wb,"Locality_root_seed_fungi",Locality_root_seed_fungi)

addWorksheet(wb,"Plot_plants")
writeData(wb,"Plot_plants",Plot_plants)

addWorksheet(wb,"Plot_gps")
writeData(wb,"Plot_gps",Plot_gps)

addWorksheet(wb,"Reintroduction")
writeData(wb,"Reintroduction",Reintroduction)


#Save file
saveWorkbook(wb, here::here("data", "Herminium_monorchis_masterfile_v_2026.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```
